name: Mayor Bartleby Crumbwell
note: The halfling mayor of Curdmoor, up for re-election the week after the festival and not handling this well. Hired the party. Will cry in at least one language per scene he appears in. Not a threat to anyone but himself.

abilities.name: Strategic Sobbing
abilities.desc: No mechanical effect. Deeply effective on anyone with a shred of empathy.
